register.labelZh: HAND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: hand over 和 hand somebody back 可以幫助講者、主持人和記者,把節目或討論順暢地交給另一人。；hand over 可以表示把項目、店舖或工作交給另一人管理。；hand in 表示提交;hand back 表示歸還;hand on 表示傳給下一個人;hand round 表示逐一傳給所有人。；hand down 可以描述衣物、物件、食譜、歌曲或故事由年長家人傳給年輕一代。
register.summaryEn: Hand over and hand somebody back help speakers, presenters and reporters pass a programme or discussion smoothly from one person to another. Hand over can describe giving a project, shop or job to another person to manage. Hand in means submit, hand back means return, hand on means pass to the next person, and hand round means pass to everyone. Hand down describes clothes, objects, recipes, songs or stories passing from older family members to younger ones.

questions.answer: The note is only for team leaders. After reading it, hand it on to the next leader.
questions.answerZh: 這張便條只給組長閱讀。看完後,把它傳給下一位組長。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 把物件或資料傳給下一個人

questions.prompt: The shop worker found the stolen watch and gave it to the police when they arrived.
questions.promptZh: 店員拾到失竊的手錶,警方到場時便把手錶交給他們。
questions.answer: The shop worker found the stolen watch and handed it over to the police when they arrived.
questions.answerZh: 店員拾到失竊的手錶,警方到場時便把手錶交給他們。
questions.targetForm: hand somebody/something over (to somebody) / hand yourself over (tosomebody)
questions.targetMeaningZh: 把某人、某物或自己交給警方或負責人員

questions.prompt: Although the work was difficult, every student submitted the finished report before the lesson ended.

questions.answer: Although the work was difficult, every student handed the finished report in before the lesson ended.
questions.answerZh: 雖然作業很困難,但每名學生都在課堂結束前交了完成的報告。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 提交功課、表格或文件

questions.answer: The office is changing managers, and Omar will hand over to Grace on Monday.
